program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 1000

source_provenance: Sider Scholar/OpenAlex + NCBI PubMed exact-source verification

policy.validation_strategy: PMID-level dedupe/source verification during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 1000

waves.focus: Randomized triple-blind HMB free-acid trial in trained/untrained men with high-intensity functional exercise; aerobic-capacity support was more apparent than strength, with training-status and regimen boundaries.
Open-label randomized post-COVID trial in 43 adults; ICAM-1 decreased and 6-minute walk improved, while body composition did not differ between groups; disease-specific and small-study evidence.
33-study exercise meta-analysis; modest HI sprint, mean-power and VO2max signals with potential athlete/sport/timing modifiers; performance context only.
Acute randomized trial in adults with high/low ADHD traits; 5-HTP produced no significant positive effect on distractibility measures, providing a useful null counterweight.
Pilot 6-week RCT in 20 physically active older women; sit-to-stand improved, while several between-group performance, biomarker and QoL outcomes were nonsignificant; preliminary evidence.
Very small randomized crossover in 11 trained male sprinters; acute 8-g CM modestly improved repeated 100-m performance and reduced pre-second-sprint RPE; acute athletic context only.

Three-week proprietary fiber-blend RCT in 26 IBS patients following low-FODMAP diets; microbiota and GI-specific anxiety changed while gut symptoms, sleep and measured biomarkers remained stable/null.
Acute crossover T2D study; black tea with inulin+dextrin reduced postprandial glucose fluctuation/AUC and insulin response versus placebo; combination-only evidence.
Systematic review of 80 controlled diet trials; taxonomy and biomarker changes occurred across diets but alpha/beta diversity changes were not consistent; broad dietary category evidence only.
Cancer-treatment SR/MA: gut-microbiome interventions reduced GI adverse events overall with high heterogeneity, while objective cancer-treatment response did not clearly improve.
Seven-RCT/187-participant elderly-constipation meta-analysis; stool frequency was not significantly improved, while laxative/enema use fell and bifidobacteria increased.
Long-term randomized-evidence review of maternal/early-childhood micronutrient supplementation; most cognitive outcomes were null with a few modest domain-specific developmental signals.
Broad orthopedic nutrition meta-analysis; BMD/biochemical/inflammation/recovery signals contrasted with null fracture-healing and functional/muscle outcomes; high heterogeneity limits attribution.
Nine-RCT/547-participant hypertension/elevated-BP meta-analysis; resting SBP/DBP and cardiometabolic markers were null, with only a small ambulatory DBP signal and low/very-low certainty.
Eleven-RCT/360-participant review; chronic polyphenols did not establish reliable added strength, lean-mass or muscle-morphology adaptation beyond resistance training.
Twenty-RCT mental-health systematic review; some psychological/sleep/microbiome signals but cortisol/stress findings inconsistent and strain/population/outcome heterogeneity substantial.
Twenty-four-RCT three-level meta-analysis; small soreness benefit, but muscle-damage biomarkers and performance effects remained uncertain with low/very-low certainty.

Eight-week RCT in 132 adolescents with irritability; some clinician/parent outcomes improved while one primary irritability measure was null; subgroup effects and pediatric formulation context retained.

Triple-blind trial of a four-herb topical cream versus conventional cream; both improved symptoms, but no significant between-group effect or interaction was shown; combination-only and high-dropout context.
Older-adult trial of strawberry leaf extract for self-reported memory complaints; leaf material must remain distinct from strawberry fruit and sponsor/product provenance retained.
Mentha spicata + Amaranthus seed flour + flavonoids/B-vitamins trial; highest-dose lipid signals belong only to the multi-ingredient combination.
Small 28-day Ulva lactuca trial in healthy adults; biomarker-only outcomes, 18 completers and industry provenance require cautious research-only handling.
Twelve-week Ecklonia cava + Chrysanthemum indicum RCT; respiratory signals with some QoL nulls, attributable only to the combination.
Broad naturopathy review retained for research mapping only; exact intervention-level extraction is required before any canonical claim.
Published correction associated with probiotic bone-health evidence; correction provenance must travel with any downstream use of the corrected source.
